result:
The tests pass! ✓

All 10 tests passed, including tests that validate `parse_inr` works correctly as the inverse of `format_inr`. The implementation:
- Parses formatted rupee amounts like `"₹1,23,456.78"` back to paise (12345678)
- Rejects text without the rupee sign by raising `InvoiceError("BAD_AMOUNT", text)`
- Handles negative amounts like `"-₹1,23,456.78"` correctly
- Properly strips whitespace and removes Indian-style comma grouping
